answer: Sybil Divergence Check Each agent must maintain a unique behavioral signature across independent tasks. The system assigns agents to random, isolated work zones—wharf operations, meadow surveys, lagoon monitoring—where outcomes are compared only after full execution. Clones, lacking true divergence, produce identical results when given the same inputs. The mechanism detects such repetition through statistical clustering of outputs. An attacker must deploy distinct identities that independently generate varied, verifiable actions across zones.
